name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 7 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 1.38 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
